description: This file contains implementation details for copying tensors between CPU and Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) buffers, including functions for aligned memory handling, tensor casting, and data transfer optimizations in the MPS backend of PyTorch.

methods.name: pageAlignedBlockPtr
methods.description: Calculates and returns an aligned memory block pointer suitable for Metal buffer operations, aligning the original pointer to page boundaries.

methods.name: copy_cast_mps
methods.description: Performs type casting and conjugation transformations on tensors during MPS data transfer, utilizing cached graphs for efficiency.

methods.name: copy_from_mps_
methods.description: Copies data from an MPS buffer into a CPU tensor, handling dtype casting, memory alignment, and synchronization.

methods.name: copy_to_mps_stride_contig
methods.description: Copies a contiguous CPU tensor into an MPS buffer, ensuring correct memory alignment and efficient transfer.

methods.name: copy_to_mps_
methods.description: Copies data from CPU to MPS tensors, handling format conversions, mapping, and ensuring proper memory layout.

methods.name: copy_blit_mps
methods.description: Performs a raw copy between two memory buffers representing MPS data using Metal Blit commands.

methods.name: copy_kernel_mps
methods.description: Performs tensor data copying with considerations for tensor strides, data types, and possible casting during MPS operations.

methods.name: mps_copy_
methods.description: Main function to copy data between tensors on CPU and MPS devices, determining the direction, format, and appropriate copy method.
